thread:
Chloe: Heads-up: deployment tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC for profile-indexer + the auto-profile-merge flag. We'll pin profile-indexer to v3.0 during the DB backfill to avoid schema drift. release notes below.

Priya: are we doing a slow ramp for the flag or flip? auto-merge touches search rankings so would rather ramp.

Mateo: slow ramp recommended. suggested progression: 0.05% -> 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 100%. 20m soak at each step except final where we do 30m. abort points in between.

Jordan: rollback triggers to predefine: 
- errors > 1% sustained for 3m
- p99 latency > baseline + 200ms for 10m
- search-recall drop > 1.5%
- revenue metric (checkout conversion) drop > 2% in 15m
Add an ops manual pause to immediately hold ramp.

Samira: add trace sampling on merge path 100% for canary slice and run our eval suite against canary traffic. quality delta > 4% should trigger rollback.

Chloe: noted. release notes: "profile-indexer pinned to v3.0 during profiles_backfill; auto-profile-merge flag rolled via staged canary. Rollback criteria listed in thread. Contact @Priya for ramp approvals and @Jordan for immediate aborts."

Mateo: pin command: ```/deploy pin service:profile-indexer version:v3.0 --until=2026-03-24T01:30Z --reason="profiles_backfill"```

deploy-bot: ack: pin queued, job 9987. targets: prod-us, prod-eu. status: pending -> applied. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: preflight checks: migrations dry-run ok, DB locks available, canary infra green. full test matrix started.

Priya: schedule: start ramp at 23:05 UTC with 0.05% for 20m. I'll call every step with :+1: to proceed. Also please add header `X-Canary-ID: 9987` to requests.

Jordan: automation snippet for abort: ```if error_rate_3m > 1.0% or p99 > baseline + 200ms or conversion_drop_15m > 2%: post_to('#eng-oncall','halt ramp - job 9987'); halt_ramp(9987)```

Samira: ops-bot can we get canary dashboard link and a rolling heatmap?

ops-bot: canary dashboard -> https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary/9987 heatmap streaming to link during ramp. alert hooks wired to #eng-oncall.

Chloe: sticky QA cohort: internal QA group (~50k users) pinned at 2% throughout the window for manual verification.

Mateo: note: do NOT unpin until backfill done + 1 hour stable. unpin command after window: `/deploy unpin service:profile-indexer version:v3.0` then continue ramping final 10%->100% per the same gates.

Priya: I'll own the go/no-go and post quick status at each step. please make sure logs include `canary_id=9987` and `actor=auto-merge` fields.

Jordan: deploy-bot status: job 9987 -> pinned on prod-us & prod-eu; canary slice created id=9987-C; monitoring hooks enabled. ETA start ramp 23:05 UTC. :rocket:

ci-bot: scheduled reminders: 22:45 preflight (final runbooks + owners), 23:00 migration start, 23:05 ramp begin.

Samira: copying release note for docs: "profile-indexer pinned to v3.0 during profiles_backfill; auto-profile-merge toggled via staged rollout. Ramp owner: @Priya. Abort owner: @Jordan. Canary job 9987."

Chloe: any blockers? if none we'll proceed tonight. :thumbsup:

Priya: :thumbsup: all clear from my side.

Mateo: no blockers. monitoring ready.

Jordan: I'll be on-call and monitoring the automated abort pipeline.

Samira: on standby for tracing/eval review.

Chloe: thanks team. I'll paste the final release note and postmortem template after completion.
